Team — quick handover note following signatures this morning. OnePulse (Alex/Maya) executed the SOW; deal id OP-2026-0456. High level context and initial asks below so CS can pick up with staging plan.

Background / what they bought:
- Dedicated Redwood Dedicated pool (4xA100 equivalent GPUs) for inference endpoints, reserved 12-month commit.
- On-prem connector (VPN + collector) for audit logs and KMS integration (customer-managed keys).
- Redwood Optimize setup with initial quality baseline (prompt set) and batching profile.

Key success criteria (customer):
1) Acceptable 99th percentile latency under 220ms for their 512-token median inference path.
2) Full audit-log ingestion into their SIEM during pilot window (3 weeks).
3) Smooth cutover with no production data leakage and validated KMS rotation.

Immediate next steps (please action):
- Tessa: recommend sprint0 owner + initial staging timeline (target: internal staging in 2 weeks, pilot in 5).
- Karthik: assign PM buddy to help with internal acceptance gates and exec updates (weekly).
- Contracts/Legal: confirm the two redline items we agreed (retention term tweak and scheduled maintenance blackout). Alex, Contracts — loop in if missing.

Attachment: attached the signed SOW v2 (OnePulse_SOW_v2.pdf) and a first-pass risk register I'm pushing into the Drive link.

Alex / Maya — thanks for the quick execution. Tessa will reach out to schedule the kickoff for next week. Ben
